kai: Heads-up: getting intermittent 403s from users behind auth-proxy after yesterday's RBAC roll. Affected users have recent SCIM updates. Logs show a mix of 'InvalidAudience' from IdP and a KMS decrypt error for the service token. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes: maria: Copy. Can you paste the exact log lines? Also which service accounts are failing? kai: Sure — here's the snippet from proxy logs:
`2026-02-12T09:42:11Z auth-proxy ERROR request_id=0a1b2c user=alice@example.com idp_err=InvalidAudience aud="https://redwood.example.com/api" svc_token_err=KMSDecryptError: context_mismatch alias="alias/redwood-prod-v2"` Seems to correlate with users who were moved to team:edge last night. oliver: Hmm. We rotated a KMS alias yesterday for a quantized-store rollout, but the alias should be backed by the same key material. Did we update the token encryption context consumers? maria: If KMS decrypt yields context_mismatch, the JWE protected header likely has a different encryption_context map. Maybe SCIM or the enrolment job added a new externalId attribute that changed how tokens are minted. jamie: I ran a quick query — 7 SCIM events for team:edge between 02:00-02:15 where externalId ends with a capital letter (e.g., "svcAcctA" vs "svcacta"). Could be case normalization bug. kai: Good catch. The IdP's NameID normalization is lowercase, but our SCIM import preserves original case. So tokens minted earlier use lowercase extIDs, new ones use mixed case. KMS policy enforces exact context match. maria: Quick mitigation: add a temporary fallback in token validator to try both lowercase and original externalId when deriving encryption_context, and open a ticket to normalize SCIM. That should reduce 403s while we fix upstream. oliver: I'm wary of expanding validators — increases blast radius. Can we instead add a shim in the auth-proxy that normalizes the externalId before deriving the context? Smaller surface. jamie: I can push a small patch to proxy in canary (staging first). Command to grep affected users: `SELECT user_id FROM scim_events WHERE event_type='update' AND team='edge' AND externalId ~ '[A-Z]' LIMIT 500;` kai: Created an incident page: https://incidents/redwood/INC-2026-041 — tagging sec oncall. @sec-bot can you post the recent KMS rotation audit? sec-bot: KMS rotation audit attached: rotated alias "alias/redwood-prod-v2" -> new key 1234abcd at 2026-02-12T01:58:00Z. No failed decrypts reported at rotation time. Policy unchanged. maria: Ok, plan: 1) Jamie pushes proxy shim to canary with extID lowercase attempt (10:30AM PT). 2) Oliver verifies KMS audit and rotation metadata (immediate). 3) Kai monitors 403 rate and rolls back if spike. 4) Follow-up: SCIM normalization RFC and a backfill job. jamie: On it. Will post PR and canary link. kai: Thanks. If anyone sees a regression, ping #eng-oncall and I'll escalate. maria: Also, add an eval alert to Redwood Console for token decrypt failures so we get signal next time. oliver: One more note — check role-binding caches (RBAC) for case-sensitive keys; if cache keys differ, users might be authorized but cache miss causes re-eval and a different token path. kai: Good point. Adding cache flush to mitigation checklist. sec-bot: Incident INC-2026-041 created, priority P2. Assigned: jamie, kai, oliver. Updates will be posted here. :clipboard:
